criteria.requirement: Repair cli.view to use Event.start/end/duration rather than deriving a separate zero-length default. An all-day DATE DTSTART with no DTEND/DURATION has the model-defined exclusive next-day end and one-day duration; timed events without end remain zero-length. Preserve explicit DTEND/DURATION, floating/aware display rules and model validation of illegal combinations. Do not hardcode dates or change the Event model to fit CLI output.

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
